personal_info.name: Hakim Jonas Ghoula
personal_info.title: Software Engineer & Systems Architect
personal_info.summary: Software engineer with four years in distributed data systems and an independent track record in library, parser, and language work. Primary languages: Scala 3, Rust, Dart, Python. Verified publisher on pub.dev under ardaproject.org with packages for parser combinators, multi-format parsing, codec derivation, and a total query language. Author and maintainer of a Scala 3 validation library on Maven Central. Educational background in IT and Cognition (MSc) and Philosophy (BA), University of Copenhagen.

experiences.description: Distributed data systems for AdTech and MarTech identity resolution. Apache Spark pipeline development and testing, with contributions to data governance, infrastructure automation, and AI agent systems. Code owner for multiple warehouse modules.
achievements: Built an AI agent system using a dual-process architecture that separates deterministic fact validation from LLM reasoning. Used for automated configuration workflows.
Wrote a developer-productivity CLI integrating GitHub, GitLab, and Jira, with an MCP server for AI assistant integration.
Designed a warehouse-wide exclusion and governance framework. Configuration-driven, applied across delivery pipelines.
Implemented compile-time JSON schema derivation in Scala for configuration validation.
Maintained Apache Spark ETL pipelines for identity resolution and audience segmentation, with Specs2 test coverage.
Integrated the UID2 protocol for cross-partner identity resolution.
Built a PersonID matching system with normalized address resolution.

experiences.description: Developed NLP components for B2B lead intelligence platform, including email prediction models and multilingual language detection.
achievements: Built email prediction pipeline using pattern matching and probabilistic models
Implemented language detection module for multilingual content classification

experiences.description: Contributed to the development of a new data model for the insurance customer database.
achievements: Implemented white-label solutions and managed web projects for external partners
